integrity: Every numerical profile follows from an explicit finite-field coordinate partition and the rank-of-powers identity; exhaustive finite tests corroborate but do not certify the infinite-family statement.
scientific_limitations: The theorem counts elements of a fixed nilpotent commutant, not conjugacy orbits or general Jordan types. Related support classifications and square-zero subcases are previously known; historical priority for the all-type numerical census is not independently established.
title: Complete nilpotent Jordan multiplicities in finite-field hook centralizers
